item.title: REF 0.3.1
item.description:
• "Quieter than the reference" now always shows under Start here, however small, and leads the summary line. In EDM it's the first thing you hear next to a reference. Louder still waits its turn.
  • The loudness note now says how loud your mix sounds as well as its LUFS, for example "By ear it sounds 2.3 dB quieter". It uses perceived loudness (ISO 532-1 sones), the same measure as the Sones button in the A/B, and says why when the two measures disagree.
